page.layout: Running head at top right, with page number 883 above it; then division heading "LIBER TERTIUS." centred; one column of running text in roman type, with an italic summary paragraph below it, and a catchword and gathering signature at the foot. Faded text at the far left edge belongs to the neighbouring page and is not transcribed.

main_text.head: LIBER TERTIUS.
main_text.p: [H?]ereditatis ab intestato tres sunt ordines: 2. & in uno ordine sunt plures gradus. 3. Secundus universalis acquirendi nodus est bonorum possessio. 4. Tertius est acquisitio per arrogationem. Hactenus de dominio. 5. Deinceps agitur de obligatione: quæ vel ex contractu nascitur, vel ex quasi contractu, vel ex delicto, vel ex quasi delicto. 6. Constituuntur alii re perficiuntur, ut mutuum, commodatum, depositum, pignus: 7. alii verbis, ut stipulatio (8. quæ est unum reum, vel per duos reos: 9. & vel est prætoria, judicialis vel communis, vel conventionalis; 10. vel est utilis, vel inutilis: 11. item vel est repromissio, 12. alii literis: 13. alii consensu, 14. ut emptio & venditio. 15. locatio & conductio. 16. societas, 17. mandatum, 18. Quasi contractus negotiorum gestio, tutela, rei vel hereditatis petitio, aditio hereditatis, solutio indebiti. 19. Communes obligationibus ex contractu, & ex quasi contractu est, 20. & certis modis tollitur[?]

p.i: De hereditatibus quæ ab intestato deferuntur. 2. De gradi-cognatorum 3. De bonorum possessionibus. 4. De acquisitione per arrogationem. 5. De obligationibus. 6. Quibus modis re contrahitur obligatio. 7. De verborum obligationibus. 8. De duobus reis stipulandi & promittendi. 9. De divisione stipulationum. 10. De inutilibus stipulationibus. 11. De fidejussoribus. 12. De literarum obligationibus 13. De obligationibus ex consensu. 14. De emptione & venditione. 15. De locatione & conductione 16. De societate. 17. De mandato. 18. De obligationibus quæ quasi ex delicto nascuntur. 19. Per quas personas nobis obligatio acquiritur. 20. Quibus modis tollitur obligatio.

page.notes: Faded text at the far left edge (x < 160 of the scan) belongs to the adjoining page and is not transcribed. The initial letter of the first paragraph is partly hidden by a shadow, so the H is doubtful. Several words at the left of the lines are cut by the shadow strip and were read from their right-hand parts (for example "depositum" and the start of "Constituuntur"); these are only partly legible. The final words of the italic summary and the last words of the main text are partly obscured by the fold.
